findings.title: Hook example is a silent no-op outside managed session
findings.problem: The example pipes a SessionStart payload into `codemie hook --agent claude`. In hook.ts a non-OTLP agent run outside a CodeMie-managed session (no CODEMIE_SESSION_ID and CODEMIE_AGENT) exits 0 before any processing (hook.ts:1675), so the documented command does nothing and prints nothing.
findings.impact: A reader who runs the example sees no effect and no error and may conclude the hook is broken. Trigger: running it by hand in a normal shell, which is how a docs example is typically tried.
findings.recommendation: Note that the example takes effect only inside a CodeMie-managed session (CODEMIE_SESSION_ID and CODEMIE_AGENT set), or use an OTLP agent name such as claude-code-otlp.
findings.check_notes: COMMANDS.md:1975 now states the example only takes effect in a managed session (CODEMIE_SESSION_ID and CODEMIE_AGENT) and that OTLP agents skip the check; matches hook.ts:1660-1679.

fix.change: Added a note under the codemie hook example that it only takes effect in a CodeMie-managed session (CODEMIE_SESSION_ID and CODEMIE_AGENT set), else exits 0 silently; OTLP agents skip the check

findings.title: Hook exit codes omit transcript_path and exit 1
findings.problem: The Exit codes paragraph lists only invalid JSON, missing session_id or hook_event_name, and broken auth as exit 2. hook.ts also exits 2 when transcript_path is missing on events other than SessionStart and SessionEnd (hook.ts:1486-1497), exits 1 for any other handler failure with a stderr reason (hook.ts:1755-1758), and exits 0 for non-CodeMie sessions and OTLP agents without field checks. This is the partial on AC2.
findings.impact: Hook authors misread failures: a missing transcript_path blocks the agent with exit 2 and a failed handler exits 1, neither of which is documented.
findings.recommendation: Add that exit 2 also covers a missing transcript_path on events other than SessionStart/SessionEnd; other handler failures exit 1 with a one-line stderr reason; non-CodeMie sessions and OTLP agents skip field checks and exit 0.
findings.check_notes: COMMANDS.md exit-codes paragraph now covers missing transcript_path (non-SessionStart/SessionEnd), exit 1 with stderr reason, and exit 0 for non-managed/OTLP; matches hook.ts:1486-1498 and 1755-1758.

fix.change: Extended the codemie hook Exit codes paragraph with missing transcript_path (exit 2), other handler failures (exit 1 with stderr reason), and non-managed or OTLP runs (exit 0)

findings.title: Placeholder heading would be reported as unregistered
findings.problem: COMMAND_HEADING maps any heading starting with `codemie <words>` to a command name. A future heading such as `codemie <agent>` or `codemie --help` would map to a non-command name and the reverse rule would report it as not registered.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: no current COMMANDS.md heading matches (checked), so there is no failure today; a future heading would produce a false failure with a clear message and an easy workaround.
findings.recommendation: Ignore headings whose first word after codemie does not start with a letter, e.g. `if (m && !/^[a-z]/i.test(m[1].trim())) return [];` in headingCommandPath.
